newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to target 114-31 if 114-08 holds.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to target 114-31 if 114-08 holds.

text.p: September gilts will aim to reach 114-31 on Tuesday, as long as the contract manages to hold above key support at 114-08, technical analysts said.
But a break below that level would open up the potential for a move down to around 113-25, they added.
"We broke 114-07,10 yesterday which had caused some problems for a few days," said David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London.
"That ought to get us up to the big high at 114-31 -- that's on the cards as long as we hold 114-08."
The market hit a contract high of 114-31 on May 9.
Wood said a break below 114-08, daily highs from June 12 and June 6, would open up the potential for a move to 113-30, then 113-25.
Charts show the market hit a daily high of 113-25 on June 5, 113-26 on June 11 and 113-27 on June 3.
"That was a decent barrier on the way up and is pivotal in the big picture," said Wood. "If we get below 113-25 the picture would skew to the downside and the 113-00 area."
Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase, agreed that provided the market remained above 113-25, it would extend its recent rally.
"Provided it remains above here, it will put 114-16 under renewed presure and once above here it will test 114-31 represented by the previous contract high," he said in a note for clients.
"This must be broken to trigger a momentum buy signal by the nine week Relative Strength Index."
He said a weekly closing price above 115-10 suggested 117-25 ahead of 121-01, the top traded on continuation charts in December 1993.
By 0704 GMT, September gilts were up 1/32 at 114-14. September short sterling was unchanged at 93.18.
